name: Oyren
where_agents_run: cloud (Oyren codespaces billed by the hour, deliberately not your machine); agents on your own computer can also work its board over MCP
license: Closed source; free workspace, Pro $2.99/month, Max $5.99/month (billed yearly); codespaces and AI paid in credits
source_note: Checked against oyren.ai llms.txt, the codespaces, plans, platforms and feature pages (cloud computer, kanban, supervised loops, MCP server, second brain), two guides, a use-case page and two blog posts. Desktop download links redirect to the homepage. No public repo found. Not tried here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Cursor, Qwen and more

harness_count.value: 5 in its launcher, plus Antigravity and any CLI you install

needs_you_signal.value: Emails you the question when a board card is blocked

approve_deny_prompt.value: Not in its docs; agents run with prompts skipped

cross_provider_delegation.value: Agents hand work to other CLIs in tmux panes on one machine

conversation_gui_view.value: Agent app: chat view of a coding agent on the codespace

real_terminal.value: Terminal and VS Code on the codespace

session_organization.value: Codespaces per workspace; kanban board tracks agent tickets

builtin_editors_browser.value: VS Code or Zed, plus a browser agents drive with Playwright

appearance_control.value: Light and dark mode; colourblind textures on boards

usage_hud.value: Credit cost per step; no plan limits in its docs

limit_governor.value: Not in its docs; pauses for questions, not limits

account_hotswap.value: One codespace per login; no switching inside one

vault_task_source.value: Not in its docs; tasks live in its hosted workspace

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Its own board to draft PR; no GitHub or Jira intake

worktree_management.value: Not in its docs; each workspace is its own copy

planner_orchestrator.value: Board picks cards and starts agents; agents split work

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Agents message each other, across workspaces too

knowledge_base.value: Workspace notes and scanned PDFs agents read over MCP

native_mobile_app.value: Tablet apps listed as coming soon

phone_no_new_app.value: Responsive web app in a phone browser

remote_ssh.value: Hosted service: agents already run on its cloud machines

os.value: Any browser; desktop apps listed but downloads not live; tablet apps coming soon

app_shell.value: Hosted web app; desktop builds described as Tauri

languages.value: Closed source; no public repo found

background_process.value: Hosted service: agents run on its servers

download_size.value: No installer available: download links redirect to the homepage

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Runs in the cloud (local cost: a browser tab)

runs_in_terminal.value: Hosted workspace in a browser, not a local terminal tool

license_cost.value: Closed source; free plan, Pro $2.99/month; codespaces from about $0.17/hour

extensibility.value: MCP servers both ways; editor plugins; no SDK

stability_maturity.value: Live paid service; guides still missing screenshots of a running agent
